title: Facebook Profile, Group & Page Details Scraper
description: Scrapes comprehensive metadata from Facebook profiles, groups, and pages.

targetUrls.title: Target URLs
targetUrls.description:
Facebook profile, group, or page URLs — one per line.

Supported:
• https://www.facebook.com/username
• https://www.facebook.com/profile.php?id=123456
• https://www.facebook.com/groups/groupname
• https://www.facebook.com/pagename

cookies.title: Facebook Cookies
cookies.description:
Your Facebook session cookies (must contain c_user and xs).

Formats: JSON array, JSON object, Netscape, or header string.

fbDtsg.title: fb_dtsg Token (Optional)
fbDtsg.description: Facebook CSRF token. Leave blank to auto-fetch.

scrapeMembers.title: Scrape Group Members
scrapeMembers.description: For groups: scrape the member list.

maxMembers.title: Max Members
maxMembers.description: Max group members to scrape (0 = unlimited).
